title: Compare Android Party dispatch with shared synthetic state
platforms: Android core on host Linux; actual Android untested
changes: Record paired fork and pinned upstream Party gallery dispatcher and direct hook tests using matching synthetic state and isolated source copies.
validation: Two synthetic tests pass in each isolated offline host build: upstream handles modeled member and updates the modeled hook fields; fork does not.
limitations: Profiles and ROM signature were fabricated; no full guest execution, authenticated ROM, JNI tap, real scene, native dispatch, cache, emulator or device test. Upstream emitted two unused-function warnings.
